listing.name: Sanguinary Autonomist Defectors
listing.summary: With the authorization of the creator of Shadowyard, i made a fan mod of Shadowyard. Not the best, but special. This fan mod is composed of Kitbashing and re-use code/sound/weapons.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a hostile mini-faction that spawns randomly with their own mothership and loots blueprints.

description:
Download here 1.2
Requires LazyLib, GraphicsLib, MagicLib
No visible conflict with Nexerelin. Version Checker Available, Do not need Shadowyard for work

Descriptions:
With the authorization of the creator of Shadowyard, i made a fan mod of Shadowyard. Not the best, but special.
This fan mod is composed of Kitbashing and re-use code/sound/weapons.

This is a mini-faction who act like remnant, they spawn randomly on the sector, with their own mothership.
You are aware of their presence with a warning beacon because they are hostile to you.

They are not so hard than Remnant but they can loot many blueprint.

And others...

Important informations about the mod:
Except the 2 mothership, everything is technically finish. You can maybe found atleast 5 starsystem on the entire universe.

aiDescription: Adds a fan-made faction based on Shadowyard, composed of kitbashed assets. This faction acts like a remnant, spawning randomly across the sector with a warning beacon to alert players of their hostile presence. While not as difficult as Remnants, they are capable of looting many blueprints.
